documentation: Path of the texture file, relative to the game or mod root. Forward and back slashes are both accepted; the file must exist (a .tga reference may fall back to a shipped .dds).
First texture of a progress bar or masked shield: the fill texture revealed as the bar advances.
Second texture of a progress bar or masked shield: the background texture being masked.
Third texture of a masked shield or trade route: the overlay texture blended on top.
Alpha mask texture blended over the sprite (used by the diplomacy overlay icons).

GUI shader effect driving the sprite's button states, named after a gfx/FX shader such as buttonstate. The engine resolves the compiled shader by name, so the historical .lua spelling of these references no longer exists on disk even in vanilla.
When the texture is loaded: FRONTEND sprites load for the main menu, INGAME sprites load with a campaign.
Number of frames stacked vertically in the texture; the engine crops the sprite to one frame and advances on demand.
Whether the engine tests the texture for transparent pixels (disable for full-frame textures).
Marks the texture as fully transparent so the engine skips per-pixel transparency handling.
Keeps the texture permanently loaded by skipping reference counting.
Legacy flag restoring the pre-lazy-loading texture lifetime for the sprite.
Sound played when the sprite is clicked as a button.
Duration of one scrolling or rotating animation cycle of the animated overlay, in seconds.
Motion of the animated overlay: scrolling (the vanilla default), rotating, or pulsing.
Playback speed of a frameAnimatedSpriteType, in frames per second.
Whether a frameAnimatedSpriteType restarts after the last frame.
Whether a frameAnimatedSpriteType starts playing when its window becomes visible.
Seconds a frameAnimatedSpriteType rests on the last frame before looping.
Whether a progress bar fills horizontally instead of vertically.
Progress bar fill colour as an RGB float block: color = { 0.0 0.5 0.0 }.
RGB channel value between 0.0 and 1.0.
Progress bar background colour as an RGB float block.
RGB channel value between 0.0 and 1.0.
Pixel size block of a cornered tile sprite: size = { x = 10 y = 10 }.
Width in pixels.
Height in pixels.
Corner border thickness of a corneredTileSpriteType: borderSize = { x = 2 y = 2 }.
Horizontal border thickness in pixels.
Vertical border thickness in pixels.
Overlay animation played over the sprite texture (rotating or scrolling effects).
Mask restricting where the animation texture is drawn.
Texture scrolled or rotated over the sprite by the animation.
Frame count of the animation texture.
Whether the animation restarts after its last frame.
Seconds the animation waits before starting.
Rotations per second applied to the animation texture.
Initial rotation angle of the animation texture, in radians.
Blend mode used when drawing the animation over the sprite.
Scale factor applied to the animation texture.
Columns in the overlay frame grid of a masked shield.
Rows in the overlay frame grid of a masked shield.
Object name. pdxmesh names are referenced by map ambient objects via their type blocks.
Mesh file of a pdxmesh object, such as gfx/models/Units/x.mesh.
Particle-system name played by a pdxparticle object.
Uniform scale applied to the object.
Camera distance beyond which the object stops rendering (values may carry an f suffix).
Diffuse texture of an arrowType map arrow.
Normal-map texture of an arrowType map arrow.
Specular texture of an arrowType map arrow.
Shader effect for the object, a gfx/FX/*.lua file.
Texture of a tradeRouteType, relative to the game or mod root.
First texture of a tradeRouteType arrow.
Second texture of a tradeRouteType arrow.
Third texture of a tradeRouteType arrow.
Animation clip bound to a pdxmesh: animation = { id = "idle_01" type = "gfx/models/x.anim" }.
Animation clip name referenced by the mesh's .anim metadata.
Animation clip bound to the state id: a shared clip name such as polearm_onehanded_attack_animation or seagulls_idle, resolved from the compiled unit animation set rather than a loose file path.
Per-mesh material overrides for a pdxmesh.
Zero-based mesh index the settings apply to.
Name of the sub-mesh the settings apply to.
Shader name used to render the sub-mesh.
Shader source file for the sub-mesh.
Diffuse texture override for the sub-mesh, a bare file name resolved relative to the mesh's own directory rather than the game root.
Normal-map texture override for the sub-mesh, a bare file name resolved relative to the mesh's own directory rather than the game root.
Specular texture override for the sub-mesh, a bare file name resolved relative to the mesh's own directory rather than the game root.
Scroll speed of an animatedmaptext label.
Rendered text of an animatedmaptext label: font, colour, and position settings.
Diameter in pixels of a PieChartType chart.
Pixel size block of a LineChartType chart: size = { x = 152 y = 40 }.
Width in pixels.
Height in pixels.
Stroke width of a LineChartType chart.
Font name referenced from .gui files via font = "...".
Font file stem under gfx/fonts, without extension: path = "gfx/fonts/vic_36".
Default text colour as an ARGB hex literal, such as 0xffffffff.
Text outline colour as an ARGB hex literal.
Whether the font's shader effect is enabled.
Per-colour-code font variants: the G, R, Y (and optionally H, T) blocks override the font used for each localisation colour code.
Wrapper block containing all sprite definitions (spriteType, textSpriteType, progress bars, shields, animated sprites).
Wrapper block containing bitmap font definitions.
Wrapper block containing engine object definitions (pdxmesh, arrows, particles, map text, charts).
Plain sprite: one texture file with optional frame slicing and load behaviour.
Sprite whose texture is rendered behind dynamic text (names, numbers).
Progress bar sprite: texturefile1 fill over texturefile2 background, coloured through color and colortwo.
Tiled sprite whose corners stay fixed while edges and centre stretch (size and bordersize).
Shield sprite masking texturefile with an overlay grid (texturefile3, overlay_frames_per_row, overlay_rows).
Frame-by-frame animated sprite (animation_rate_fps, looping, play_on_show, pause_on_loop).
Global cursor hotspot offset for every edit box: cursor_offset = { -5 -4 }.
Bitmap font definition: name plus texture atlas path and colour tables.
Mesh object referencing a .mesh file with optional animations and texture overrides.
Map arrow object: texture, normal, and specular maps plus the arrow shader effect.
Trade route object: arrow texture set and a cull distance.
Particle system object driven by a named particle type.
Pie chart object sized in pixels.
Line chart object sized in pixels with a line width.
Floating map text label with a scroll speed and one or more textblock style blocks.
Localisation-rendered text of the label.
Text colour as an RGB float block: color = { 1.0 1.0 0.0 }.
RGB channel value between 0.0 and 1.0.
Bitmap font name, declared by a bitmapfont block in an interface .gfx file.
Pixel position of the text block: position = { x = 0 y = 0 }.
Horizontal pixel offset.
Vertical pixel offset.
Text alignment within the block; vanilla uses centre.
